description: This PHP class 'EmergencyContact' within the OrangeHRM system represents an Emergency Contact Data Transfer Object (DTO). It handles the retrieval and normalization of emergency contact information for a specific employee, identified by employee number. The class provides methods to convert the object to an array of selected fields, utilizing ORM references and traits for database interaction.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: A DTO class managing emergency contact data for an employee, including conversion to array and field mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmergencyContact object with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized emergency contact fields for the employee.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to getter methods for emergency contact properties.
